synthesis_basis: S01/S02/S03/S04/S07 completed artifacts only; no external runtime rerun.

entries.name: Current Parser Baseline Map
entries.role: Defines current parser/conversion/refusal contracts used to compare external tools.
gaps_or_limits: baseline is comparison substrate, not a new parser implementation
entries.downstream_implication: All sidecar candidates must map to SourceRef/EvidencePath/PageIndex/SemanticChunk/review boundaries before graph claims.

entries.name: GROBID Scholarly Parsing Study
entries.role: Scholarly TEI sidecar candidate for metadata, headers, sections, bibliography, citation/ref markers, and TEI structure.
strengths: 3/3 PDFs processed through Docker CRF service
gaps_or_limits: bibliography/citation quality comparison with full/DL image if accuracy matters
entries.downstream_implication: Use as scholarly structure sidecar behind TEI adapter and independent review; not table/OCR/graph-readiness proof.

entries.name: OpenDataLoader OCR Layout Table Probe
entries.role: Layout/OCR/table/coordinate sidecar candidate via hybrid docling-fast backend over local PDFs.
strengths: layout/page/bounding-box candidates useful for EvidencePath/PageIndex review
gaps_or_limits: No scanned/image-only PDF was included, so OCR quality remains not proven.
No independent table ground truth was used, so table fidelity is qualitative only.
Outputs are candidate evidence only and are not graph-ready or import-eligible.
Need a larger probe before production adoption or sidecar schema commitment.
entries.downstream_implication: Use for candidate layout/table/page evidence only; OCR/table fidelity and source-span quality require larger future quality gates.

entries.name: Adaptix OpenDataLoader Adapter Probe
entries.role: Typed adapter candidate mapping fixed OpenDataLoader JSON into daily-archive candidate summaries.
gaps_or_limits: structural mapping is not semantic validation
does not prove reading order, table fidelity, source-span correctness, or graph readiness
entries.downstream_implication: Keep Adaptix as post-processing adapter layer after fixed parser output, followed by daily-archive validators and review gates.

entries.name: QuantMind Architecture Pattern Study
entries.role: Architecture pattern source for TreeKnowledge/PageIndex, PaperKnowledgeCard, provenance, pipeline separation, bounded concurrency, and resolver guardrails.
entries.downstream_implication: Use patterns only under daily-archive-owned schemas; do not adopt quant-mind runtime, GraphKnowledge, storage, retrieval, RAG, or OpenAI/API flow.
